hooks.name: 10-linux-modules-post.hook
hooks.exec: /bin/sh -xc 'KVER="${KVER:-$(uname -r)}"; if test -e "/usr/lib/modules/backup/${KVER}"; then rsync -AHXal --ignore-existing "/usr/lib/modules/backup/${KVER}" /usr/lib/modules/; fi; rm -rf /usr/lib/modules/backup'

hooks.name: texinfo-install.hook
hooks.exec: /bin/sh -c 'while read -r f; do if test -f "$f"; then install-info "$f" /usr/share/info/dir 2> /dev/null; fi; done'
